prompt: Leave the voicemail your dad leaves after you already texted him that your flight landed.
response:
Hey kiddo, it’s Dad. Just checking to see if you landed, even though I know you said you landed. I just wanted to hear it, I guess.  

Hope the flight was okay and they didn’t lose your bag. Text me when you get in the Uber—actually don’t text while you’re walking around, just… when you’re settled.  

Mom says don’t forget to eat something. I say don’t pay airport prices unless you have to.  

Alright, love you. Proud of you. Call me when you get a chance. No rush. But, you know… when you get a chance. Bye.
